label: Road vehicle
description: Generic cars, trucks, buses, bicycles, motorcycles, work vehicles, and fictional ground transport.
frame: the ___ is parked beside the road
notes: Generic road and ground vehicle types belong here, including bicycles, work machinery, and recognizable classic forms. vehicle.rail owns vehicles confined to rails; vehicle.aircraft, vehicle.watercraft, and vehicle.spacecraft own their respective transport. Values are bare type names without manufacturers, models, paint colors, or occupants. Real vehicles remain available in contemporary scenes, including preserved classics; only fictional forms carry genre tags.
